name: adequacy_residual
interpretation: minimum layer-dissolving currency invisible to the native probe family

inputs.E: finite-dimensional legal carrier or energy quotient
inputs.C: positive semidefinite audit with null-mode legality enforced

optimality_identity: K_{D-AL,D-AL} = Xi_C(D|L) + (A-A_*) K_LL (A-A_*)^*, A_* = K_DL K_LL^dagger
exact_adequacy_equivalences: exists A with D_0 = A L_0
strict_extension_monotonicity: Xi_C(D|L,M) = Xi_C(D|L) - K_{DM|L} K_{MM|L}^dagger K_{MD|L} <= Xi_C(D|L)
same_family_saturation: If M factors through L, the decrement is zero.
status: manuscript-grade proof target; also candidate standalone paper
